title.zh: 授权契约登记官在其办公室签发的产权证书及其他需盖章的文件上使用本办公室印章，而非初审法院印章的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Register of Deeds to Use the Seal of His Office, Instead of that of the Court of First Instance in Certificates of Title and Other Papers Which Require a Seal and Which are Issued by His Office
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Register of Deeds to Use the Seal of His Office, Instead of that of the Court of First Instance in Certificates of Title and Other Papers Which Require a Seal and Which are Issued by His Office

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1947/ra_113_1947.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The provisions of existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, all certificates of title, certified copies of documents, certificates of entry or registration, and other papers which require a seal, and which are issued by the register of deeds of the province or city, shall be sealed with the seal of his office.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 7, 1947
